summary: A tour can't be built from what's here yet. This is what it needs:
items: 2 of 8 works were found in the installation photos. Wide photos that show the others, 2–3 works and a corner in each, would place them.
Size missing, or not matching the work's image: Gallery, Group solo exhibition, Carpet TV, Carpet 2. Please check width and height.
Only 2 of the room's 4 walls could be measured. Photos of the other walls, with a work or a corner in them, are needed.
Only 43% of the walls are in the photos. Every wall should be in at least two photos.
The surest way: a slow walk-through video of the room, a minute or two, filming every wall.
